sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
j=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],env={**os.environ,'PM2_HOME':'/root/.pm2'},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
assert j.returncode==0
app=[x for x in json.loads(j.stdout) if x.get('name')=='telegram-robot-leads']
assert len(app)==1
meta=app[0]['pm2_env']
print('STATUS',meta.get('status'),'PM2_UNSTABLE_RESTARTS',meta.get('unstable_restarts'),'RESTART_TIME',meta.get('restart_time'))
for stream_name,log_name in [('OUT','pm_out_log_path'),('ERROR','pm_err_log_path')]:
 p=Path(meta.get(log_name,''))
 if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():continue
 with p.open('rb') as h:
  n=h.seek(0,2);h.seek(max(0,n-30000));lines=h.read().decode('utf-8','replace').splitlines()
 print('STREAM',stream_name,'TAIL_LINE_COUNT',len(lines))
 for line in lines[-20:]:
  try: entry=json.loads(line)
  except ValueError:continue
  if isinstance(entry,dict):
   allowed={k:entry.get(k) for k in ('status','reason','public_discovery_status','group_actions_recorded','groups_joined','blocked_actions') if k in entry}
   print('SANITIZED_CYCLE',json.dumps(allowed,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True)[:550])
state=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json')
d=json.loads(state.read_text())
for account in ('1','2'):
 acc=d['accounts'][account]
 print('ACCOUNT',account,'BLOCKED',acc.get('blocked'),'REASON',str(acc.get('reason'))[:120],'JOIN_COUNT',acc.get('group_joins'))
print('PENDING_GROUPS_COUNT',len(d.get('pending_group_actions',{})))
print('JOINED_GROUPS_COUNT',len(d.get('joined_groups',{})))
print('DIAGNOSIS_COMPLETE')
PY
